exodus.34.p1.b1.text: Chisel out two stone tablets like the originals, and I will write on them the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

exodus.34.p1.b2.text: Be ready in the morning, and come up on Mount Sinai to present yourself before Me on the mountaintop.

exodus.34.p1.b3.text: No one may go up with you; in fact, no one may be seen anywhere on the mountain …

exodus.34.p2.b4.text: So Moses chiseled out two stone tablets like the originals.

exodus.34.p2.b5.text: He rose early in the morning, … he went up Mount Sinai as the LORD had commanded him.

exodus.34.p2.b6.text: … taking the two stone tablets in his hands, …

exodus.34.p3.b7.text: And the LORD descended in a cloud, stood with him there, and proclaimed His name, the LORD.

exodus.34.p3.b8.text: The LORD, the LORD God, is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness, …

exodus.34.p3.b9.text: Moses immediately bowed down to the ground and worshiped.

exodus.34.p3.b10.text: O Lord, … if I have indeed found favor in Your sight, my Lord, please go with us. …

exodus.34.p4.b11.text: Behold, I am making a covenant. Before all your people I will perform wonders that have never been done in any nation in all the world. …

exodus.34.p4.b12.text: … All the people among whom you live will see the LORD’s work, …

exodus.34.p4.b13.text: Rather, you must tear down their altars, smash their sacred stones, and chop down their Asherah poles.

exodus.34.p4.b14.text: For you must not worship any other god, for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.

exodus.34.p5.b15.text: Do not make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, for when they prostitute themselves to their gods …

exodus.34.p5.b16.text: You shall make no molten gods for yourselves.

exodus.34.p5.b17.text: You are to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread. For seven days … you are to eat unleavened bread … For in the month of Abib you came out of Egypt.

exodus.34.p5.b18.text: The first offspring of every womb belongs to Me, … No one shall appear before Me empty-handed.

exodus.34.p6.b19.text: Six days you shall labor, but on the seventh day you shall rest; even in the seasons of plowing and harvesting, you must rest.

exodus.34.p6.b20.text: Three times a year all your males are to appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.

exodus.34.p6.b21.text: So Moses was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking water. …

exodus.34.p6.b22.text: … He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant—the Ten Commandments.

exodus.34.p7.b23.text: And when Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands, he was unaware that his face had become radiant from speaking with the LORD.

exodus.34.p7.b24.text: Aaron and all the Israelites looked at Moses, and behold, his face was radiant. And they were afraid to approach him.

exodus.34.p7.b25.text: But Moses called out to them; so Aaron and all the leaders of the congregation returned to him, and Moses spoke to them.

exodus.34.p7.b26.text: And after this all the Israelites came near, and Moses commanded them to do everything that the LORD had told him on Mount Sinai.

exodus.34.p8.b27.text: When Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil over his face.

exodus.34.p8.b28.text: But whenever Moses went in before the LORD to speak with Him, he would remove the veil …

exodus.34.p8.b29.text: … And when he came out, he would tell the Israelites what he had been commanded …

exodus.34.p8.b30.text: and the Israelites would see that the face of Moses was radiant. So Moses would put the veil back over his face until he went in to speak with the LORD.
